Additionally, he increases in [[File:Gameplay radius.png|20px|link=Unit size|An icon representing the keyword Gameplay radius]] [[:Unit size|size]] by 18% while reducing the target's size by 9.9%.@@description2@@Half of the drain's '''total''' damage, healing, and resistances reduction is applied on-cast, while the other half is applied every second over the next 4 seconds. @@leveling3@@{{{leveling3}}}@@leveling4@@{{{leveling4}}}@@leveling5@@{{{leveling5}}}@@leveling6@@{{{leveling6}}}@@range@@{{{range}}}@@radius@@{{{radius}}}@@effectradius@@{{{effect radius}}}@@width@@{{{width}}}@@speed@@{{{speed}}}@@casttime@@0.25@@cost@@100@@cooldown@@120 / 110 / 100 / 90 / 80@@targeting@@Unit@@damagetype@@magic@@spellshield@@True@@projectile@@{{{projectile}}}@@notes@@ * ''Subjugate'' deals [[File:Blaze.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Persistent damage]] [[:Damage|persistent damage]], additionally tagged as [[File:Irelia Vanguard's Edge.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Indirect damage]] [[:Damage|indirect damage]], and applies [[File:Blackfire Torch item.png|20px|link=Ability effects|An icon representing the keyword Ability effects]] [[:Ability effects|spell effects]]. * ''Subjugate'' will snapshot the values of the target's '''current''' '''maximum''' health, '''total''' armor, and '''total''' magic resistance as soon as it completes its cast. The drain debuff will calculate the remaining half of the damage, healing, and resistances reduction based on these snapshotted values, even if the target's health or resistances change. The snapshot lasts until the debuff expires. * The target's resistances will be further reduced by 5% per drain tick, up to 20% by the end of the drain (totaling to 40% reduction from the initial 20% reduction on-cast). * '''Trundle''' will gain the reduced resistances of the target for himself for as long as they remain reduced, including while they are lingering after the drain. * The resistances gained is based on the current reduced resistances of the target; the total amount that would be reduced is not granted to '''Trundle''' all at once. In other words, he will initially gain 20% of the target's resistances, then the remaining 20% over the 4 seconds, gaining additional bonus resistances equal to the resistances reduced per drain tick. * '''Trundle''' gains 11.7 extra [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] range on his [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] (relative to his and enemy center) as a consequence of his increased [[File:Gameplay radius.png|20px|link=Unit size|An icon representing the keyword Gameplay radius]] [[:Unit size|size]]. ** So do his enemies. ** He gains 3.78 to 6.255 range against the target he ''subjugated'', depending on their base size, and so does the target against him. * The debuff on the target also ''persists through death''. * '''Trundle''' will lose the buff if the target loses the debuff, for example if it enters [[File:Revival icon.png|20px|link=Death#Ways to prevent death when reaching zero health|An icon representing the keyword Resurrection]] [[:Death#Ways to prevent death when reaching zero health|resurrection]].(unexpected) * If the target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]], or is too far away or no longer in [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).@@
